## Hackathons

- **2015 · [Safer Baltimore Biking](http://kbroman.org/jhudashbike/)**, JHU Data Science
  Hackathon. Used open Baltimore City data on accidents and road hazards to map road
  safety; geocoded hazards and helped build the final Leaflet map.
- **2015 · IdEar**, [MedHacks 1.0](http://medhacks.org/). A proof of concept that ears can
  act as biometric markers where population registries are poor, using SIFT features and
  an SVM. Top 10 of 30 teams.
